Those are reported deaths and hospitalisations, not a total case count. Authorities ordered water and food sampling; the source was not established in the article. Media-reported, not independently verified by WaterGuard.

Down To Earth reported foul-smelling and visibly polluted tap water in the Kachna Housing Board area for more than a month and around 100 people reporting illness. The article did not specify a clinical diagnosis or give a verified case count. Report date is the review publication date; map position is city-level.

Down To Earth reported that residents of Sector 70A had diarrhoea and gastrointestinal illness after drinking tap water in early December 2025; around 60 to 70 people were reportedly affected and at least 10 hospitalised. These are source-reported estimates, not a verified case count. Report date is the review publication date; map position is approximate.

Down To Earth reported that more than 150 children were admitted to hospital with typhoid in early January after consuming contaminated water. Admissions are not a confirmed total case count. This is distinct from the 2024 Gandhinagar cholera report. Report date is the review publication date; map position is approximate.
